claims: NASA's Artemis II mission has successfully launched as of April 1, 2026.
Artemis II marks the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis II mission crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission duration is ~10 days.
The Artemis II mission involves testing the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II launch vehicle is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission launched from Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II crew will fly around the moon but not land.
Reid Wiseman is the Commander of the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover is the Pilot of the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen is from the Canadian Space Agency.
A goal of the Artemis II mission is to test Orion’s life-support systems.
A goal of the Artemis II mission is to perform a manual flight maneuver.
A goal of the Artemis II mission is to validate systems for future lunar landings (Artemis III).
The Artemis II mission will fly further into space than any human has gone before.
The Artemis II mission will surpass the distance of Apollo 13.
During Days 1-2 of the Artemis II mission, there will be testing of Orion systems in Earth orbit.
During Days 1-2 of the Artemis II mission, there will be a translunar injection burn to head toward the moon.
On Day 6 of the Artemis II mission, the spacecraft will perform a lunar flyby.
On Day 6 of the Artemis II mission, the spacecraft will reach its closest point to the moon.
On Day 6 of the Artemis II mission, the spacecraft will reach its farthest distance from Earth.
On Day 10 of the Artemis II mission, the spacecraft will return to Earth.
On Day 10 of the Artemis II mission, there will be testing of the heat shield against temperatures near 2,700°C (4,900°F).
